name: Kyokou Eiyuu GinGaia
source:
This tale tells a story, that of a paternal odyssey, the coming of age into fatherhood. 
Kanbara Hideo lived an ordinary life, surrounded by his wife and kids. 
However, one day, cast into a world of ruin, a barren wasteland, he encounters a giant kaiju. 
Run, Hideo, Run. What appeared infront of him, was a mysterious robot... 
Oh how typical! Oh how orthodox. A lovely heroic tale. 
But, this was no orthodox hero journey. There was no room for hopes and dreams here...


[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/3611892/]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一个关于父亲的冒险故事，即成年后成为父亲的故事。
神原秀夫过着平凡的生活，周围有妻子和孩子。
然而有一天，他被扔进了一个废墟世界，一片贫瘠的荒原，遇到了一只巨大的怪兽。
跑吧，秀夫，跑吧。出现在他面前的，是一个神秘的机器人…… 
哦，多么典型啊！哦，多么正统啊。一个可爱的英雄故事。
但是，这并不是正统的英雄之旅。这里没有希望和梦想的空间……


[翻译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/3611892/]BOOTH[/url]]
